notes: Source categories focus on basic foods; some category members include preparation/ingredients and retain their full source descriptions.
No branded or survey records, baby food, beverages/alcohol, sweets, restaurant/fast-food or snack categories.
Required missing values are excluded, never guessed or converted to zero.
Nutrients normalized from per 100 g; energy priority 1008 then 2048 then 2047 (kcal only).
Source IDs/variants retained; common-food aliases select individual representative records, not averages.
